title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三章、皇帝的命令

    绑匪的画里画了一个食盒。包拯问王府里有没有这样的食盒，他想看看。管家福康马上让人去拿了。
    很快，大厅的地上摆了十多个食盒。包拯弯下腰去，一个一个拿起来仔细看。
    “盒子提手上的花纹有什么特别的意思吗？怎么这两个的花纹和别的不一样？”包拯指着两个食盒问。
    “这两个是宫里的食盒，是今年中秋节时皇上给王爷送点心用过的。提手上的花纹是宫里的，和王府食盒的花纹不一样。”福康说。
    包拯眼睛一亮，把画纸拿到这两个食盒旁边仔细看了看，画里的花纹和食盒上的花纹好像是一样的。皇帝似乎也认出来了，吃惊地说：“这幅画里的食盒是宫里的？送信给王爷的人是宫里来的？”
    包拯摇摇头：“很像，但不完全一样，您看，画里的花纹更复杂一些。”
    皇帝疑惑了：“那这是哪儿的食盒？”
    这时，站在皇帝身边一直没有说话的太监总管张怀向前走了一步，他盯着看了一会儿，犹豫了一下，说道：“这是宫里的花纹，只不过不是现在的，是很久以前的。宫里年纪大点的人都见过。”
    “张总管，你在宫里多少年了？”包拯问。
    张怀一直看着画里的食盒，不知道是在想什么，还是没有听到包拯的话，直到皇帝开口说：“张怀是宫里的老人了，他和太后同年进宫，是二十多年前的事情了。”张怀这才像是突然明白过来，忙说道：“是的，我跟着太后已经二十多年了。我想起来了，画里这个食盒的花纹是我进宫时就有的，宫里用了很多年，直到前几年才没用的。”
    包拯仔细看了一会儿，然后站了起来，他盯着皇帝的眼睛说：“八王爷被绑架的原因，和宫里有关，和以前的旧事有关。皇上，这个案子，您愿意让我查吗？您愿意让我查多少呢？如果和很重要的人有关，我能一直查下去吗？”
    “想救八王爷，非包拯不可，这是绑匪的话。查此案，也非包拯不可，这是我的话。这个案子不管和谁有关，你都要查下去，这是我给你的命令。”皇帝的语气沉重，目光坚定。
    包拯没有说话，他的眼睛里有和皇帝一样坚定的光，他点了点头。
    “还有，八王爷不能有事，你要好好地把他给我带回来。如果带不回来，那八王爷去了哪儿，包拯你也要去哪儿，明白吗？”皇帝再说，语气沉重。
    包拯弯腰说道：“如果不能救回八王爷，包拯愿以死谢罪。”
    皇帝看着包拯低下去的头，眼睛里有泪水闪过，但很快他又收了回去，然后转身离开了王府。
fullText.traditional:
第三章、皇帝的命令

    綁匪的畫裡畫了一個食盒。包拯問王府裡有沒有這樣的食盒，他想看看。管家福康馬上讓人去拿了。
    很快，大廳的地上擺了十多個食盒。包拯彎下腰去，一個一個拿起來仔細看。
    “盒子提手上的花紋有什麼特別的意思嗎？怎麼這兩個的花紋和別的不一樣？”包拯指著兩個食盒問。
    “這兩個是宮裡的食盒，是今年中秋節時皇上給王爺送點心用過的。提手上的花紋是宮裡的，和王府食盒的花紋不一樣。”福康說。
    包拯眼睛一亮，把畫紙拿到這兩個食盒旁邊仔細看了看，畫裡的花紋和食盒上的花紋好像是一樣的。皇帝似乎也認出來了，吃驚地說：“這幅畫裡的食盒是宮裡的？送信給王爺的人是宮裡來的？”
    包拯搖搖頭：“很像，但不完全一樣，您看，畫裡的花紋更複雜一些。”
    皇帝疑惑了：“那這是哪兒的食盒？”
    這時，站在皇帝身邊一直沒有說話的太監總管張懷向前走了一步，他盯著看了一會兒，猶豫了一下，說道：“這是宮裡的花紋，只不過不是現在的，是很久以前的。宮裡年紀大點的人都見過。”
    “張總管，你在宮裡多少年了？”包拯問。
    張懷一直看著畫裡的食盒，不知道是在想什麼，還是沒有聽到包拯的話，直到皇帝開口說：“張懷是宮裡的老人了，他和太后同年進宮，是二十多年前的事情了。”張懷這才像是突然明白過來，忙說道：“是的，我跟著太后已經二十多年了。我想起來了，畫裡這個食盒的花紋是我進宮時就有的，宮裡用了很多年，直到前幾年才沒用的。”
    包拯仔細看了一會兒，然後站了起來，他盯著皇帝的眼睛說：“八王爺被綁架的原因，和宮裡有關，和以前的舊事有關。皇上，這個案子，您願意讓我查嗎？您願意讓我查多少呢？如果和很重要的人有關，我能一直查下去嗎？”
    “想救八王爺，非包拯不可，這是綁匪的話。查此案，也非包拯不可，這是我的話。這個案子不管和誰有關，你都要查下去，這是我給你的命令。”皇帝的語氣沉重，目光堅定。
    包拯沒有說話，他的眼睛裡有和皇帝一樣堅定的光，他點了點頭。
    “還有，八王爺不能有事，你要好好地把他給我帶回來。如果帶不回來，那八王爺去了哪兒，包拯你也要去哪兒，明白嗎？”皇帝再說，語氣沉重。
    包拯彎腰說道：“如果不能救回八王爺，包拯願以死謝罪。”
    皇帝看著包拯低下去的頭，眼睛裡有淚水閃過，但很快他又收了回去，然後轉身離開了王府。

sentences.traditional: 皇帝的語氣沉重，目光堅定。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì de yǔ qì chén zhòng mù guāng jiān dìng
sentences.english: The emperor’s tone was grave, and his gaze was resolute.

sentences.simplified: 包拯没有说话，他的眼睛里有和皇帝一样坚定的光，他点了点头。
sentences.traditional: 包拯沒有說話，他的眼睛裡有和皇帝一樣堅定的光，他點了點頭。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng méi yǒu shuō huà tā de yǎn jing lǐ yǒu hé huáng dì yí yàng jiān dìng de guāng tā diǎn le diǎn tóu
sentences.english: Bao Zheng did not speak. His eyes held the same resolute gaze as the emperor’s. He nodded.

sentences.simplified: “还有，八王爷不能有事，你要好好地把他给我带回来。
sentences.traditional: “還有，八王爺不能有事，你要好好地把他給我帶回來。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu bā wáng ye bù néng yǒu shì nǐ yào hǎo hǎo de bǎ tā gěi wǒ dài huí lai
sentences.english: “Also, the Eighth Prince must not be harmed. You must bring him back to me safely.

sentences.simplified: 如果带不回来，那八王爷去了哪儿，包拯你也要去哪儿，明白吗？”
sentences.traditional: 如果帶不回來，那八王爺去了哪兒，包拯你也要去哪兒，明白嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ dài bù huí lai nà bā wáng ye qù le nǎ'r bāo zhěng nǐ yě yào qù nǎ'r míng bai ma
sentences.english: If you cannot bring him back, then wherever the Eighth Prince goes, Bao Zheng, you must go too. Do you understand?”

sentences.simplified: 皇帝再说，语气沉重。
sentences.traditional: 皇帝再說，語氣沉重。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì zài shuō yǔ qì chén zhòng
sentences.english: The emperor spoke again, his tone grave.

sentences.simplified: 包拯弯腰说道：“如果不能救回八王爷，包拯愿以死谢罪。”
sentences.traditional: 包拯彎腰說道：“如果不能救回八王爺，包拯願以死謝罪。”
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng wān yāo shuō dào rú guǒ bù néng jiù huí bā wáng ye bāo zhěng yuàn yǐ sǐ xiè zuì
sentences.english: Bao Zheng bowed and said, “If I can’t save the Eighth Prince, I, Bao Zheng, am willing to atone with my life.”

sentences.simplified: 皇帝看着包拯低下去的头，眼睛里有泪水闪过，
sentences.traditional: 皇帝看著包拯低下去的頭，眼睛裡有淚水閃過，
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì kàn zhe bāo zhěng dī xià qù de tóu yǎn jing lǐ yǒu lèi shuǐ shǎn guò
sentences.english: The emperor looked at Bao Zheng’s lowered head, and tears flashed in his eyes, ..

sentences.simplified: 但很快他又收了回去，然后转身离开了王府。
sentences.traditional: 但很快他又收了回去，然後轉身離開了王府。
sentences.pinyin: dàn hěn kuài tā yòu shōu le huí qu rán hòu zhuǎn shēn lí kāi le wáng fǔ
sentences.english: .. but he quickly held them back, then turned and left the palace.

sentence_translations: Chapter 3: The Emperor’s Order
The kidnapper drew a food box in the drawing.
Bao Zheng asked if there were any such food boxes in the prince’s mansion. He wanted to take a look.
The steward, Fu Kang, immediately sent someone to fetch them.
Soon, more than a dozen food boxes were placed on the floor of the hall.
Bao Zheng bent down and picked them up one by one to examine them closely.
“Do the patterns on the box handles have any special meaning?
Why are the patterns on these two food boxes different from the others?” Bao Zheng asked, pointing at the two food boxes.
“These two are food boxes from the palace.
They were used by the emperor to send pastries to the prince during this year’s Mid-Autumn Festival.
The pattern on the handles is from the palace. It’s different from the pattern on the food boxes from the prince’s mansion,” Fu Kang said.
Bao Zheng’s eyes lit up. He took the paper with the drawing and carefully examined it next to the two food boxes.
The pattern in the drawing seemed to be the same as the pattern on the food boxes.
The emperor seemed to recognize it too and said in surprise, ..
.. “Is the food box in this drawing from the palace? Is the person who delivered the letter to the prince from the palace?”
Bao Zheng shook his head: “Very similar, but not exactly the same. Look, the pattern in the drawing is more intricate.”
The emperor was puzzled: “Then where is this food box from?”
At this moment, the chief eunuch Zhang Huai, who had been silently standing next to the emperor, took a step forward.
He stared at it for a while, hesitated, and then said, ..
.. “This is a pattern from the palace, but not from the present time. It’s from a long time ago.
The older people in the palace have all seen it.”
“Chief Zhang, how many years have you been in the palace?” Bao Zheng asked.
Zhang Huai kept staring at the food box in the drawing, ..
.. lost in thought or perhaps not hearing Bao Zheng’s words, until the emperor spoke, ..
.. “Zhang Huai is an elder in the palace. He entered the palace the same year as the empress dowager, which was over twenty years ago.”
Zhang Huai suddenly seemed to understand and quickly said, “Yes, I have been with the empress dowager for over twenty years now.
I remember now, the pattern on the food box in the drawing has been there since I entered the palace.
It was used in the palace for many years, until just a few years ago.”
Bao Zheng looked carefully for a while, then stood up. He stared into the emperor’s eyes and said, ..
.. “The reason for the kidnapping of the Eighth Prince is related to the palace and to past events.
Your Majesty, are you willing to let me investigate this case? How much are you willing to let me investigate?
If it involves very important people, can I continue investigating?”
“Want to save the Eighth Prince, it must be Bao Zheng. Those are the kidnapper’s words.
To investigate this case, it must be Bao Zheng. These are my words.
No matter who is involved in this case, you must continue investigating. This is my order to you.”
The emperor’s tone was grave, and his gaze was resolute.
Bao Zheng did not speak. His eyes held the same resolute gaze as the emperor’s. He nodded.
“Also, the Eighth Prince must not be harmed. You must bring him back to me safely.
If you cannot bring him back, then wherever the Eighth Prince goes, Bao Zheng, you must go too. Do you understand?”
The emperor spoke again, his tone grave.
Bao Zheng bowed and said, “If I can’t save the Eighth Prince, I, Bao Zheng, am willing to atone with my life.”
The emperor looked at Bao Zheng’s lowered head, and tears flashed in his eyes, ..
.. but he quickly held them back, then turned and left the palace.
